captions.caption: A person pours cooked food from a bamboo tube onto a large banana leaf.
More pieces of wood ear mushrooms and bamboo shoots fall onto the leaf.
The bamboo tube is tilted further to release the rest of the contents.
A large pile of steaming food accumulates on the green banana leaf surface.
The last bits of the meal are emptied from the bamboo container.
The person shakes the bamboo tube to ensure all the food is out.
The bamboo tube is completely emptied onto the steaming pile of food.
The person sets the empty bamboo tube down on the bamboo table.
Steam rises from the freshly cooked pile of mushrooms and bamboo shoots.
The person prepares to start eating the meal from the banana leaf.
The person reaches for a pair of bamboo sticks to use as utensils.
The person picks up the bamboo sticks and adjusts their grip.
The person uses the sticks to separate a piece of wood ear mushroom.
The person brings a piece of the cooked food towards their mouth.
The person begins to eat the wood ear mushrooms and bamboo shoots.
A close-up shows the person picking up a dark mushroom with sticks.
The person takes a bite of the mushroom and starts chewing.
The person continues to pick at the food pile with the bamboo sticks.
Another piece of mushroom is lifted from the pile on the banana leaf.
The person eats while looking directly at the camera.
The person picks up a large, dark wood ear mushroom slice.
The person chews the mushroom while holding the sticks ready.
The person reaches back into the pile for another piece of food.
Steam continues to rise as the person eats the hot meal.
The person picks up a piece of bamboo shoot with the sticks.
The person takes a bite and continues chewing the cooked meal.
The person moves some mushrooms around to find the next bite.
A piece of meat or chicken is picked up from the pile.
The person eats the piece of meat and chews thoroughly.
The person continues to enjoy the meal outdoors in the forest.
Another slice of wood ear mushroom is picked up with the sticks.
The person brings the mushroom to their mouth and eats it.
The person picks up a small piece of food from the leaf.
The person chews while looking down at the remaining food.
The person picks up a long strip of bamboo shoot from the pile.
The person eats the bamboo shoot strip and continues to chew.
The person reaches for another dark mushroom piece on the leaf.
The person takes another bite and looks around their environment.
The person continues to eat the variety of ingredients in the meal.
The person picks up a piece of meat with the bamboo sticks.
The person eats the meat and continues to chew.
The person picks up a large piece of wood ear mushroom.
The person takes a bite of the mushroom and chews.
The person continues to eat from the steaming pile on the leaf.
The person picks up another piece of food with the sticks.
The person eats and looks at the camera while chewing.
The person picks up a small piece of bamboo shoot.
The person eats the bamboo shoot and continues the meal.
The person picks up another slice of wood ear mushroom.
The person takes a bite and looks satisfied with the food.
The person reaches for one of the last few pieces of food.
The camera angle changes to a wide shot of the person in a shelter.
The person sits at a bamboo table under a palm leaf roof in the forest.
A small dog is visible on the table next to the person's food.
The person continues to eat while the dog watches from the table.
The person picks up food and eats in their primitive forest shelter.
The person is seen sitting on the ground next to the bamboo table.
The person wipes their forehead with their hand while eating.
The person continues to eat the meal on the banana leaf.
The person takes another bite of food in the wide-angle view.
